title: Meeting Notes Taker
description: Turns messy notes into a short action list.

fields.text:
Meeting notes - product sync:
- Sarah will finalize the pricing page copy by Friday.
- Dev team is blocked on the payments API key, need it from finance by Wednesday.
- Marketing wants a launch date decision by end of week.
- Everyone agreed to push the beta invite list out this afternoon.

fields.task: Read these meeting notes and reply with a numbered list of action items, one per line, each with the owner if named.

fields.text: Hi, I ordered a replacement charger two weeks ago and it still hasn't arrived. The tracking number hasn't updated in 9 days. This is the second time this has happened with your shipping. I'd like a refund or an expedited replacement.

fields.task: Write a short, empathetic customer support reply to this complaint. Offer an expedited replacement. Keep it under 80 words.

fields.text: This lightweight jacket packs into its own pocket and keeps you dry in a sudden downpour.

title: Customer Reply Translator
description: Writes a reply, then translates it to German.

fields.task: Reply with exactly: Your refund has been processed and will appear in 3-5 business days.

fields.task: This is raw OCR text from an invoice. Reply with a markdown table with one data row (no extra commentary), with columns Description, Quantity Hrs, Unit price, Amount, using the invoice's own fields. If a field is missing, use "unknown".
